course_outcomes.text: Explain the characteristics and methodology to design IoT system
Identify various devices required for different IoT applications.
Describe various IoT protocols for communication between different endpoints to develop client server application.
Explain various elements of IoT Securities
Make use of various cloud offering available for IoT Platform
